UGA.note: Training is for informal-sector traders, not civil servants.

facts.fact: The Gender, Labour and Social Development ministry, with Huawei, runs the Digi-Truck mobile classroom project launched in March 2023, which had benefited 8,192 Ugandans by September 2025, including 350 graduating in Amuria district on 5 September 2025.

systems.owner: Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development with Huawei
